$comment: Single source for the /plugins download page (src/app/plugins) and scripts/build-plugin-zips.mjs, which packs every `downloads[]` entry into public/downloads/plugins/<file> before `next dev`/`next build`. `source` is relative to the repo root; `root` is the folder name the files sit under inside the zip (what the user extracts or copies into their project). `install` (optional) tells Guidon Desktop's plugin installer where the zip's `root` goes: into `<chosen folder>/<into>/`, after checking `marker` (a relative path, or `*.ext` for any top-level file with that extension) exists in the chosen folder; `folder` describes what to pick and `next` (with {server}) what to do afterwards. Downloads without it (source builds) aren't installable from the desktop app.

install.folder: Unity project folder (the one containing Assets/ and ProjectSettings/)
install.next: In Unity: Window → Guidon → Tasks, set Base URL to {server} and log in.

install.folder: Unity project folder (the one containing Assets/ and ProjectSettings/)
install.next: In Unity: Assets → Create → Guidon → Report Settings (in a Resources folder), then fill in Base Url {server}, the Project Id and a reports:write key.

install.folder: Unreal project folder (the one containing the .uproject file)
install.next: Reopen the project and let the editor build the module, then open Window → Guidon Tasks, check the Base URL ({server}) and log in.

install.folder: Unreal project folder (the one containing the .uproject file)
install.next: Reopen the project to rebuild, then in Project Settings → Plugins → Guidon Reports set Base Url {server}, the Project Id and a reports:write key.

install.folder: Godot project folder (the one containing project.godot)
install.next: In Godot: Project → Project Settings → Plugins, enable Guidon Tasks, then log in to {server} from the Guidon panel.

install.folder: Godot project folder (the one containing project.godot)
install.next: In Godot: enable Guidon Reports under Project → Project Settings → Plugins, then set Base Url {server}, the Project Id and a reports:write key in Project Settings → General → Guidon Reports.
In Blender: Edit → Preferences → Add-ons, enable Guidon Tasks and log in to {server}.
